title: Amphion RC-20 tab data, schema version 1
description: What the analysis pipeline writes for one song (SDD RC-20). Fixed by P1-04 (#49). Changing it needs a schemaVersion bump and Elijah's approval in the Issue first (ARCHITECTURE.md rule A8). Every time is song time: seconds from the start of the audio file (RC-18). The names mirror the types in demo/src/mock/types.ts. A value the analysis could not find is null and the app shows it as Unknown (RC-11). P4-03 later splits this into Firestore chunks by bar range; the notes and chords themselves keep this shape.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this format. Always 1 for this schema.

audioSha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the exact bytes of the audio file that was analyzed (RC-19). Equals `shasum -a 256 <file>`. Lets a player check it has the same file. Approved by Elijah on 2026-11-09 (A8).

duration.description: Length of the audio file in seconds, as decoded.

key.description: The song's key, for example "E minor" or "G major". null means the analysis could not tell (Unknown).

bpm.description: Tempo in beats per minute. null means Unknown.

tuningOffsetCents.description: How far the recording sits from standard pitch (A = 440 Hz), in cents. Negative is flat (DD-08). null means Unknown.

beatsPerBar.description: Beats in a bar, found with the beat grid. null when no full bar was found.

beats.description: Time of every beat, in seconds, ascending.

downbeats.description: Time of the first beat of every bar, in seconds, ascending. Each one is also in `beats`.

chords.description: Chord-name segments, in time order. Stretches with no chord are left out.

guitar.description: The guitar tab, or null when no guitar part was found.

bass.description: The bass tab, or null when no bass part was found. The app then says "No bass part found" (US-08).

name.description: Display name: a note name, with a trailing "m" for minor, for example "E", "C#m".

confidence.description: 0 to 1. null means the chord recognizer gives no score; P6-01 (OQ-01) decides how to flag chords.

edited.description: True once the user changed it. The pipeline always writes false.

duration.description: Length of the note in seconds.

string.description: String number. 1 is the highest-pitched string. null until the tab-assignment step (P1-05) fills it in.

fret.description: Fret number, 0 is open. null until the tab-assignment step (P1-05) fills it in. string and fret are both null or both set.

pitch.description: MIDI note number of the sounding note.

confidence.description: 0 to 1. How sure the note detector is.

edited.description: True once the user changed or confirmed it. The pipeline always writes false.

notes.description: Notes in time order (start time, then pitch). Guitar has six strings.
Notes in time order (start time, then pitch). Bass has four strings.
